description: Éolien flottant : appel à projet 2015 (surfaces d'emprise des sites propices identifiés) is a dataset listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by geolittoral.developpement-durable.gouv.fr. Layer locating the favorable sites of the call for projects for the establishment of floating wind pilot farms. Coverage: FR. The portal shows the English title as "Floating wind: 2015 call for projects (surfaces of right-of-way of identified suitable sites)" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include éolien;site propice. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
